description_en: Verifies the three elements of an ID card: name, ID card number, and photo. Compares the name, ID card number, and uploaded portrait photo to determine whether they belong to the same person
description_zh: 三要素（姓名、身份证号和身份证照）核验。用于比对用户填写的姓名、身份证号及上传的人像照片三项信息是否属于同一用户
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi cert-no-three-element-verification --auth-code 'QASDW@#**' --cert-name '张三' --cert-no '3***************0' --cert-picture iVBOFMKODOFNDFP123DFSMOO... --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CertNoThreeElementVerification

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code. You can obtain the value from the following sources:
Go to the Tag Marketplace (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square) in the Phone Number Verification Service console, select the Three elements of an ID card tag, and submit an application. After the application is approved, you can obtain the authorization code.
Go to the My Applications (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply) page in the Phone Number Verification Service console to view the authorization ID of the approved Three elements of an ID card application
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。取值来源：
在号码百科控制台标签广场 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/square)选择身份证三要素标签，提交使用申请，申请通过后会获得授权码。
在号码百科控制台我的申请 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)页面，查看已申请通过的身份证三要素授权ID
parameters.name: auth_code

parameters.help_en: The ID card number to be verified
parameters.name: cert_no

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded portrait photo to be verified. Remove the URI information (such as `data:image/png;base64,`) from the encoded string before you submit the request. The size of the photo and the size of the Base64-encoded string cannot exceed 50 KB
parameters.help_zh: 待核验的人像照片的BASE64编码。请去除编码后的URI信息（如`data:image/png;base64,`）后提交。照片大小和BASE64编码后的大小均不能超过50K
parameters.name: cert_picture

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to encrypt the data. Currently, only unencrypted data is supported
parameters.help_zh: 是否加密（目前仅支持不加密）
parameters.name: mask

IsConsistent.description_en:
Indicates whether the verification result is consistent. Valid values:

0: The name matches the ID card number, but the person is identified as a different person.

1: The name matches the ID card number, and the person is identified as the same person.

2: The name matches the ID card number, and the person is suspected to be the same person.

3: The name matches the ID card number, but no portrait photo is found in the database.

4: The identity information is invalid. The name does not match the ID card number.

5: The photo quality does not meet the requirements
IsConsistent.description_zh:
验证结果是否一致。返回：

0：姓名与身份证号匹配，识别为非同一人

1：姓名与身份证号匹配，识别为同一人。

2：姓名与身份证号匹配，疑似同一人。

3：姓名与身份证号匹配，库中无人像信息。

4：身份信息无效（姓名与身份证号核对不一致）。

5：照片质量不合格
